hero.tagline: I turn data-heavy systems into products that feel effortless — from the data model and API to the interface on top.

about.body: I’m a full-stack engineer based in Tunisia, working across the web and mobile stack. My sweet spot is where architecture meets experience: designing the data model, building the API, then shaping the interface until it feels obvious.
about.body2: At SBG TECHELECTRO I’m rearchitecting a production platform into microservices and building the reporting layer behind 2,000+ IoT devices. Before that, I shipped multi-tenant SaaS, mobile apps and integrations at GOFIELD — always with the same obsession: make complex systems feel simple.
about.nowDesc: Microservices, IoT reporting and analytics — the backbone of a platform used in the field every day.

backend.title: Backend Engineer
backend.ask: Own the API layer, break a legacy monolith into services, and keep production data intact through the migration.

data.title: Data Platform Engineer
data.ask: Move large analytical datasets without downtime, tune the storage model and make slow queries fast again.

product.title: Full-Stack Product Engineer
product.ask: Ship the admin web app, the field mobile app and the API behind them — across tenants, releases and CI/CD.

about.title: Engineer by craft.

about.principle2Body: A small reliable release teaches more than a perfect plan.

about.principle4Body: The API, the screen and the error message are one experience.
